display.purpose: Masthead, sheet headlines, register entries. Always uppercase, leading 0.9-0.95.

body.purpose: Working prose at 13-15px; chosen for legibility on midrange Android screens.

anno.purpose: Title blocks, dimension labels, FIG./REG./SHT numbers, table headers, button labels. Real measurement and reference data only - never prose, never a costume.

motion.name: ease-draft
motion.purpose: The single easing for every draw and settle on the page.

motion.name: duration-settle
motion.purpose: Content settling up 8px after the lines around it have drawn (Settle primitive).

motion.name: duration-draw
motion.purpose: Line drawing: scaleX for dimension lines and rules, pathLength for the elevation profile, clip-path inset wipes for plates.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Redline-filled action; hover inverts to paper/ink. Sharp edges, mono uppercase label.

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: 1px outline in the ground's text color; hover fills solid. Shown here in its paper-ground (ink) form.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #14161a); padding: 16px 28px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #14161a); border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Fragment Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-ink, #14161a); color: var(--color-paper, #f4f3ee); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-redline, #c13a2a); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The homepage presents AM Group as its own engineering drawing office: a set of numbered sheets (Sheet 00 cover through Sheet 07 plus final plate) on drafting paper, cyanotype print blue and ink, annotated with title blocks, dimension lines, registration marks and figure-numbered photography. Every claim is measured and sourced; the aesthetic IS the argument that the company is verifiable. This world governs the homepage route only - every inner page keeps the incumbent Lato / navy #023468 / red #E31837 system, and neither system may be harmonized into the other.

rules.name: The Redline Contrast Rule
rules.body: Base redline never carries small text: redline-hi on dark sheets, redline-deep on paper sheets, base for fills, lines and display-scale type. The variants exist for WCAG, not taste.

rules.name: The Sheet Alternation Rule
rules.body: Sections are sheets and alternate grounds: paper, print, paper, paper-2, ink, paper, print-deep, ink. No two adjacent sections share a ground.

rules.name: The @theme-inline Trap
rules.body: The Tailwind hookup in app/globals.css MUST stay @theme inline, not @theme: next/font's variables live on the homepage wrapper div, not :root. Plain @theme resolves var() at :root, where they are undefined, and every font utility silently falls back to the body font.

dos: Do render every fact from components/home/content.ts (which carries sources and the replacement table) or live sources (getHomeInventory(), lib/locations.ts). Never hardcode a claim in a component.

Do mark placeholders visibly: unverified years render as "c. 2000" (sinceApprox), missing photography as reserved plates / "Photo pending", missing counts as "-". The degraded inventory state renders an honest "sync down" panel, never fake cars.
Do keep tel:/wa.me links tracked only via data-track-location - the delegated LinkTracker handles GTM; no onClick.
donts: Don't apply this world to inner pages, or the incumbent Lato/navy/red to this route.
Don't use border-radius (Stamp excepted), box-shadows, icon libraries, or generic fonts (Arial/Inter/Roboto/Poppins/Open Sans/system-ui as primary faces).
Don't use Fragment Mono for prose or headlines - annotation data only.
Don't put small base-redline text on any ground - pick the contrast variant for the ground.
Don't change @theme inline to @theme for the homepage fonts (silent body-font fallback).
